news.headline: uniQure Q2 2026 Earnings Call: Confirmatory Trial Design Detailed, Net Loss Widens
news.summary: Management said the FDA wants the AMT-130 post-approval confirmatory study to use a randomized standard-of-care control arm with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint, and that uniQure is already preparing the study. Net loss widened year-over-year on higher R&D spend even as the accelerated-approval regulatory path firmed up.

news.headline: AdCom Expected for uniQure's Huntington's Gene Therapy, Chief Medical Officer Says
news.summary: CMO Walid Abi-Saab said on the Q2 earnings call that an FDA Advisory Committee review of the AMT-130 BLA is likely given it would be the first approved Huntington's disease therapy, adding "we welcome it, and we are preparing for it." No formal AdCom request has been made by the FDA yet.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 revenue of $5.8M (ahead of consensus) and cash, cash equivalents and investments of $810.3M, extending its runway into 2030 after the June $259M offering. The company confirmed it remains on track to submit the AMT-130 BLA (US) and MAA (UK) in Q3 2026, with topline 4-year Huntington's data expected in September 2026.

news.headline: uniQure Reports AMT-260 Epilepsy Data: Up to 100% Seizure Reduction in First Cohort
news.summary: Three of six low-dose patients in the Phase I/IIa trial of AMT-260 for refractory temporal lobe epilepsy had 79%-100% reductions in disabling seizures at months four to six, with no related serious adverse events. Enrollment in the higher-dose second cohort is expected to complete in Q3 2026.

news.headline: uniQure Update: AMT-191 Fabry Dosing Remains Paused Pending FDA Liver-Monitoring Agreement
news.summary: uniQure reported dose-dependent increases in alpha-Gal A enzyme activity across 11 Fabry disease patients dosed with AMT-191, but additional dosing in the mid- and high-dose cohorts remains paused pending FDA agreement on a monitoring plan following Grade 3 liver enzyme elevations in two patients.

news.headline: uniQure Closes Upsized $259 Million Public Offering
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of $259 million, capital the company says will fund AMT-130 commercialization readiness, the confirmatory study, and other pipeline programs into 2030.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 4-year topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline 4-year follow-up data from the Phase I/II Huntington's disease study expected, updating the 75% cUHDRS progression-slowing result seen at 3 years.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit the Biologics License Application for AMT-130 under the accelerated approval pathway, using 3-year Phase I/II data versus an Enroll-HD external control as the primary basis; not yet submitted as of 2026-08-28.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 UK MHRA MAA submission
catalysts.detail: Marketing Authorisation Application planned for the UK following a positive MHRA pre-submission meeting, run in parallel with the US BLA.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 epilepsy second cohort enrollment complete
catalysts.detail: Enrollment in the second, higher-dose cohort of the Phase I/IIa refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy trial expected to complete.

catalysts.label: Possible FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting
catalysts.detail: Management expects and is preparing for a likely FDA AdCom review of the AMT-130 BLA given it would be the first Huntington's disease therapy, though no formal request has been made.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 / AMT-191 program updates
catalysts.detail: Updated clinical data expected for the refractory epilepsy (AMT-260) and Fabry disease (AMT-191) gene therapy programs.

pulse: uniQure enters the back half of Q3 2026 well capitalized ($810.3M cash, runway into 2030 after the June $259M raise) and with a cleared regulatory path: the FDA has agreed 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, due for filing this quarter alongside a parallel UK MAA. The next major catalyst is topline 4-year AMT-130 data in September 2026, with management also flagging a likely FDA Advisory Committee review as a probable extra step before approval. Earlier-stage programs are more mixed: AMT-260 epilepsy data showed encouraging seizure reductions, while AMT-191 Fabry dosing remains paused pending FDA agreement on a liver-safety monitoring plan.
